001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.FleetAssignment;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.StarSystemAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.ai.CampaignFleetAIAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.ai.ModularFleetAIAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.MemFlags;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.procgen.themes.BaseAssignmentAI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
012
013public class LeashAssignmentAI extends BaseAssignmentAI {
014
015        protected StarSystemAPI system;
016        protected SectorEntityToken jumpPoint;
017        
018        protected float elapsed = 0f;
019        protected float dur = 30f + (float) Math.random() * 20f;
020        protected SectorEntityToken toGuard;
021        protected String initialApproachText = null;
022        
023        public LeashAssignmentAI(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, StarSystemAPI system, SectorEntityToken toGuard, String initialApproachText) {
024                super();
025                this.fleet = fleet;
026                this.system = system;
027                this.toGuard = toGuard;
028                this.initialApproachText = initialApproachText;
029                
030                giveInitialAssignments();
031        }
032
033        @Override
034        protected void giveInitialAssignments() {
035                pickNext();
036        }
037
038        @Override
039        protected void pickNext() {
040                fleet.clearAssignments();
041                fleet.addAssignment(FleetAssignment.ORBIT_AGGRESSIVE, toGuard, 100f);
042        }
043
044        @Override
045        public void advance(float amount) {
046                super.advance(amount);
047                
048                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_BUSY, true, 1f);
049//              Vector2f loc = new Vector2f(fleet.getLocation());
050//              loc = Misc.getPointWithinRadius(loc, 15f);
051//              fleet.setLocation(loc.x, loc.y);
052                
053                float dist = Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), toGuard.getLocation());
054                if (dist > 700 && fleet.getAI().getCurrentAssignmentType() == FleetAssignment.ORBIT_AGGRESSIVE) {
055                        fleet.addAssignmentAtStart(FleetAssignment.ORBIT_PASSIVE, toGuard, 3f, initialApproachText, null);
056                        CampaignFleetAIAPI ai = fleet.getAI();
057                        if (ai instanceof ModularFleetAIAPI) {
058                                // needed to interrupt an in-progress pursuit
059                                ModularFleetAIAPI m = (ModularFleetAIAPI) ai;
060                                m.getStrategicModule().getDoNotAttack().add(m.getTacticalModule().getTarget(), 1f);
061                                m.getTacticalModule().setTarget(null);
062                        }
063                }
064                if (dist <= 700) {
065                        initialApproachText = null;
066                }
067        }
068
069}
